title: First Philips review: DevOps strategy and quality drives delivered in four months
summary: My first year-end review recorded that within four months I formulated the DevOps architecture strategy for identity management with the team members it needed, presented it to the chief architect and leadership, and ran quality drives that showed early unit-test coverage gains.
what_would_have_happened: A new architect would spend the first months on handover and ramp-up before changing anything.
the_call: Front-load the architecture and quality work, and finish handover in the same quarter.
what_i_did: Formulated the DevOps architecture strategy with the team, presented it to the chief architect and leadership, ran quality drives, completed handover and induction, and identified top talent in the team.
what_changed: My director recorded the DevOps strategy and the unit-test coverage improvement as delivered.

quotes.text: Appreciate his effort in bringing few quality drives already in 2018 to strengthen the quality code delivery. Demonstrated already UT coverage improvement.
